messages:
Elise (Docs): Quick heads-up — while updating the migration guide for v1->v2 I hit an odd case with the embed examples. Some users swap model aliases (e.g. `embed-small` -> `embed-gen2`) and then see different vector dims in their downstream index. Need to decide how we document fallback behavior.
Samir (SDK): Yikes. Do we have a concrete repro? Can you paste the request/response?
Elise (Docs): Repro is tiny — pasted below. Notice new model returns 1536 dims, old was 1024.
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {"model": "alias:embed-gen2", "input": "hello"}
response: {"data": [{"embedding": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Jonah (Eng): That's expected if model family changed. The problem is we didn't make that explicit in the embed docs or the migration checklist.
Maya (Product): From product POV we should warn customers: swapping aliases can change vector size and break indexes. Suggest a short banner and a recipe to migrate.
Samir (SDK): On the SDK side we actually throw a runtime error if user sets an index expecting 1024 but receives 1536 — but it's messy. We should surface that in the deprecation notes and add a snippet showing a safe check:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    # fail gracefully / raise helpful error
```
Elise (Docs): Proposal: add a Migration subsection "Embed dimension changes" with: 1) checklist to validate dims, 2) sample snippet (above), 3) guidance to pin model versions/aliases.
Jonah (Eng): +1. Also add recommended rollout steps: smoke test on a small subset, update index schema, reindex if needed.
Maya (Product): Who will own the PR? We need UX copy for the banner and an inline note in the API reference.
Samir (SDK): I can add the SDK snippet and unit test demonstrating the check. Will need docs copy for the error message text.
Elise (Docs): I'll draft the banner + migration text. Can we sync on exact wording? Draft in PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/9999 — leave comments.
Samir (SDK): I left a comment in the PR about making the snippet language-agnostic and adding Go/Ruby examples.
Jonah (Eng): Engineering ask: add a short note in the model catalog that indicates vector dim per model and call out that aliases may map to different dims over time. That will reduce confusion.
Maya (Product): Agreed. Action items: Elise write PR draft, Samir add SDK snippet + tests, Jonah update model-catalog metadata flow, docs-bot: create migration checklist task.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1245 (migration: embed-dim-warning) assigned to @Elise, @Samir, @Jonah — due 2 weeks.
Elise (Docs): Thanks. One more nit: need to fix two broken links in the embedding guide (internal example app). I'll put them in the PR too.
Samir (SDK): I can help validate links. If we add code blocks, ensure fenced code uses triple backticks and we escape long arrays (no full vectors).
Elise (Docs): Right. Keep the example truncated: `[...1536 floats...]` not the full output.
Maya (Product): Timeline: banner + docs update in next sprint, SDK patch same cadence. If we surface this in the deprecation notice for the v1->v2 swap, call out the migration recipe explicitly.
Jonah (Eng): I'll queue a small telemetry spike to see how many customers would be affected by dim changes if we swap aliases next month.
Samir (SDK): Tagging @Samir for follow-up: I'll open SDK PR after tests.
Elise (Docs): Cool. I'll tag owners in the PR and request reviews from @Maya and @Jonah. Anything else?
Maya (Product): Add a short FAQ bullet: "What happens if vector dims change?" with recommended next steps. That will reduce support noise.
Elise (Docs): Will do. Closing loop here and moving items into the PR checklist. Thanks all. :tada:
